chapters.title: Make a Body
chapters.intention: Create one Body without a screen.
chapters.action: Review the clock Plot and activate Birth.
chapters.result: The installed owner retains the new Body.
chapters.why: The other Hosts must join this same Body.
chapters.next: Open the browser and QEMU guest.

media.alt: Actual nonvisual Birth session

limitations: No attended human listening is claimed.

chapters.title: Give it more places to meet you
chapters.intention: Meet the same Body on three Hosts.
chapters.action: Join through the browser and QEMU guest.
chapters.result: Three current Parts have distinct Host and Boot identities.
chapters.why: Membership does not silently birth another Body.

media.alt: Joined browser Face
Joined QEMU guest before Mask activation

limitations: QMP is emulator evidence, not physical hardware evidence.

chapters.title: Set the clock
chapters.intention: Choose a useful interval before running the clock.
chapters.action: Change the interval on ConduitOS, then change it in the browser.
chapters.result: Both typed interactions change the same owner Face.
chapters.why: The Body remains lulled while its interval changes.

media.alt: QEMU clock after the 500 millisecond action
Browser clock after the 1000 millisecond action

limitations: This does not prove distributed workload migration.

chapters.title: Change how you see it
chapters.intention: Meet the current work through different Masks.
chapters.action: Use the terminal action and change browser wardrobe preference.
chapters.result: The current Face and selected Show remain correlated.
chapters.why: Presentation changes do not make a second Body.

media.alt: Installed owner terminal Show and typed clock action
Browser wardrobe after preference change

limitations: A wardrobe choice is not a new clock action.

chapters.title: Hear it
chapters.intention: Listen to the current Face and its explanation.
chapters.result: The complete direct reading and selected model explanation have retained listener WAVs.
chapters.why: The recording is from the same Play as the speaker output.

chapters.title: Change the circumstances
chapters.intention: Understand a provider outage and its recovery.
chapters.action: Withdraw the selected model route, inspect the refusal, then restore it.
chapters.result: Model Start refuses before a new Play; a fresh selected Play completes after restoration.
chapters.why: The unavailable provider does not erase the Body or silently invoke a fallback.
chapters.next: Now leave and rejoin the browser.

media.alt: Screen-free inspection during model route loss
Restored model explanation from the selected speaker Play

limitations: No automatic fallback or workload failover is claimed.

chapters.title: Come back
chapters.intention: Return to the retained Body from a fresh browser Boot.
chapters.action: Leave the browser presentation, inspect its loss, then rejoin.
chapters.result: Old browser actions become unavailable; the fresh Boot receives a new acknowledged Show.
chapters.why: The owner preserves Body continuity while browser route identities change.

media.alt: Screen-free inspection during browser presentation loss
Fresh browser Boot showing the same Body

limitations: No QEMU reboot or workload failover is claimed.

chapters.title: Run it, then leave it well
chapters.intention: Run the configured clock and leave it in a known retained state.
chapters.action: Start the clock nonvisually, then Lull it through the same controls.
chapters.result: The clock Play runs and retires while the Body remains retained.
chapters.why: Retained identity is distinct from continuing execution.

media.alt: Nonvisual Start session
Nonvisual Lull session

limitations: A retained Body is not proof of an active Play.
